description:
Search newly registered domains from the last 60 days by keyword, or browse a single TLD without a keyword (browsing requires a registered account). Covers generic TLDs plus more than 100 country-code TLDs, including second-level registrations such as .com.br, .co.za and .co.id (tld 'br' returns the whole .br family, 'com.br' returns that suffix alone); government, military, education and non-profit categories are not included. Which country-code TLDs you can see depends on your plan; asking for one outside it returns a message saying so. Filter by recency or exact registration dates, registration term, TLD type (generic or country-code), length, character set, sale status, and nameserver; returns the cross-TLD count for each name. New registrations are folded in continuously, typically 15 to 20 minutes after registration. Dates here are day-level, not clock times.

Related tools: whois, dns, ns_reverse, typosquat

days_range.description: Registration recency: '0-30' is the last 30 days, '31-60' is 31 to 60 days ago.

exclude_ns.description: Leave out domains using these nameservers. Comma-separated, up to 10 values, each matched the same way as ns.

has_sale.description: Filter to domains listed for sale

keyword.description: Search term (min 2 chars). Substring matching applies at every length, including 2-character terms.

length.description: Domain name length: '<=15' is 15 characters or fewer, '>15' is 16 or more.

ns.description: Nameserver filter, one value. A domain such as 'cloudflare.com' matches every nameserver host under it; a full host such as 'dana.ns.cloudflare.com' matches that host only.

period.description: Registration term: '1' is one year, '>1' is longer than one year.

position.description: Keyword placement in domain name. Default is 'all' (substring match).

registered_from.description: Registered on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Combine with registered_to for a range, or set both to the same day for a single day. Takes precedence over days_range.

registered_to.description: Registered on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. See registered_from.

tld.description: Filter by TLD, e.g. 'com', 'ai', or a second-level suffix such as 'com.br'. A two-letter country code also covers its second-level registrations ('br' includes 'com.br').

tld_count.description: Cross-TLD registration count of the name (the prefix_tld_count field): '<=4', '5-20' or '>20'. Domains first seen only hours ago (live rows) carry a count of 1.

tld_type.description: Limit results to country-code TLDs ('cctld', including second-level ones such as 'com.br'; only those your plan includes) or generic TLDs ('gtld'). Omit to include both.

name: nrds

marketplace.description: Sale platform code where the domain is listed: se=Sedo, go=GoDaddy, at=Atom, vn=Venture, pd=PerfectDomain, gn=Gname, hu=HugeDomains. Present only when the domain is listed for sale.

nameservers.description: Nameserver hosts of the domain. Present on plans that include the ns filter.

prefix_tld_count.description: Number of TLDs the same prefix is registered under

price.description: Listing price with currency, e.g. 1500 USD. Only present for Atom/Sedo listings

error.description: Error message when success is false

total.description: Number of results on this page

total_found.description: Total matching results across all pages

title: Newly Registered Domains Search
